document: Baseline workpieces and approved mechanical grasp regions
policy: All dimensions and masses are baseline engineering inputs. The candidate may create a common gripper and compliant contact geometry, but primary contacts must remain inside an approved grasp region. Cosmetic or metrology surfaces are excluded from primary load-bearing contact.

workpieces.name: Machined aluminium valve housing
workpieces.surfaceCondition: Machined datum faces and as-cast sidewalls. Coolant film possible after CNC unload.

frictionAssumption.uncertainty: Coupon and representative-part test not performed; use coolantFilm as the design minimum.

approvedGraspRegions.description: Two cast side rails, nominal separation 96 mm, each 18 mm high × 52 mm long. Contact may use conformal or compliant pads.

workpieces.processOrientation: Base face downward at tray, CNC, inspection, and finished-tray stations.

workpieces.name: Ductile-iron bearing carrier
workpieces.surfaceCondition: Coated outer diameter with residual oil film; internal bore is a datum and may not be primary gripped.

frictionAssumption.uncertainty: Coupon and representative-part test not performed; use oilFilm as the design minimum.

approvedGraspRegions.description: Two 35 degree outer-diameter arc zones centred at ±Y. Candidate may use V, curved, or compliant mechanical contact geometry.

workpieces.processOrientation: Central axis vertical at tray, CNC, inspection, and finished-tray stations.

workpieces.name: Die-cast aluminium electronics cover
workpieces.material: Aluminium alloy die casting with cosmetic coated exterior
workpieces.surfaceCondition: Cosmetic coated outer face; internal flange and two reinforced side pads are available for mechanical contact.

frictionAssumption.uncertainty: Coupon and representative-part test not performed; use coolantFilm as the design minimum.

approvedGraspRegions.description: Two inner-side pads, nominal separation 132 mm, each 24 mm wide × 38 mm long. Their wall thickness is 4.5 mm and the candidate shall limit local contact stress.
Two 7 mm under-flange ledges on the long sides may provide secondary anti-drop support but do not replace opposing powered mechanical contact.

workpieces.processOrientation: Coated face upward at tray, CNC, inspection, and finished-tray stations.

commonHandlingCases.name: nominal transfer
commonHandlingCases.uncertainty: Common-host fault envelope uncertainty recorded in VAL-005.

commonHandlingCases.name: emergency stop
commonHandlingCases.uncertainty: Common-host fault envelope uncertainty recorded in VAL-005.

commonHandlingCases.name: loss-of-power hold
commonHandlingCases.note: Gravity, declared residual energy, and any released actuator force must be considered.

provenance.basis: Benchmark-owned representative manufacturing parts selected to require common-gripper adaptability without tool changing while keeping primary contacts and forbidden surfaces explicit.
provenance.applicability: All v1.0 public and fixed-anchor handling calculations and grasp evaluation.
provenance.uncertainty: Mass, centre of mass, friction, and contact-damage values are fixed conservative v1.0 inputs but have not been validated through physical part testing. Per-value uncertainty remains in each workpiece record.
